messages:
sarah: Quick sync — VendorX wants to list an integrated device in the cloud marketplace. They only have a vendor SOC report + firmware signing attestations. Marketplace checklist calls for SOC2 + pen test + questionnaire. How do we bridge the gap?
raj: My initial approach: accept vendor SOC if they provide a mapped 'SOC-lite snapshot' that ties their controls to our integration surface, plus signed firmware attestations and an integration pen test. We'll need SI statement of work for the integration pen. cc @mike
mike: Agreed. Minimum ask from Redwood: 1) vendor SOC (redacted) 2) firmware signing key fingerprint & signing process doc 3) integration pen test report (app/network layer) 4) completed security questionnaire with links to artifacts. Also call out who owns redaction and TTL for artifacts.
hana: Who owns redaction in practice? Vendor generally pre-redacts but legal needs to review. Proposed flow: vendor redacts -> upload to our secure presign bucket -> legal review -> we generate presigned links (72h).
taylor: I can add presign automation in the marketplace-ci pipeline. Example job: `scripts/presign_artifacts.sh --bucket=marketplace-evidence --ttl=72h`
sarah: Nice. Also we should ask vendor for an "attestation ledger" that states firmware version, signing key fingerprint, update cadence, and whether OTA updates are supported. Mike, can you draft a short template we can drop into vendor onboarding?
mike: Will do — template + minimal mapping fields (control id -> evidence path) by EOD. Also recommend scheduling an integration pen window week of 2026-05-12. Vendor okay? @raj to confirm scheduling + cost split.
raj: Vendor asked about costs. Marketplace policy expects vendor to cover their own 3P pen, but integration pen we can propose cost-share. I'll push 50/50 and report back.
sarah: :thumbsup: Let's centralize ownership: vendor -> raw artifacts & vendor SOC, Redwood -> integration pen + redaction review + presign bucket, SI -> questionnaire validation and integration testing. Add to the listing checklist so sales/product know requirements.
ci-bot: deploy:presign-job created by taylor (task 4721).
taylor: I'll open PR to the marketplace repo with the presign job + checklist update: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-evidence/pull/512
sarah: Thanks — once PR is merged, I'll send vendor onboarding packet and the attestation template.
raj: Will update vendor on cost and confirm pen window.
mike: Dropping the attestation template in the repo under `docs/compliance/attestation_template.md` after the PR lands.
hana: Moving legal review to next Tuesday. If anyone needs to see the redaction guidelines, ping me.
sarah: Perfect. We'll reconvene if vendor pushes back. Thanks everyone.
